text:
Samir: heads up — customers (acme-corp) seeing token meter spike when a toolcall retries and the key has burst_exempt=true. dashboard link: https://console/redwood/dash/orgs/acme/metering :eyes:
Olivia: saw a similar blip in dedicated earlier this week. I think it correlates with retries + tool attribution. @Lee any ideas? :thinking_face:
Lee: probable cause is we increment completion tokens before dedupe finishes. router issues a retry, runtime produces a second completion; both completions are recorded. we should dedupe on request_id + tool_signature
Maya: careful — deduping by request_id might let some keys bypass per-key burst limits if we also skip reservation. we need to preserve quota enforcement semantics
Jun: can someone paste repro logs? I can run a short capture on staging
Samir: pasted minimal logs below from staging where retry occurred twice and two meter entries were created:
```
2026-03-19T21:03:01.123Z INFO router request_id=R123 org=acme key=K789 tool=ocr retry=0
2026-03-19T21:03:01.456Z INFO runtime completion tokens=248 meter_event_id=M987
2026-03-19T21:03:02.000Z INFO router retrying request_id=R123 retry=1
2026-03-19T21:03:02.200Z INFO runtime completion tokens=248 meter_event_id=M988
2026-03-19T21:03:02.300Z INFO metering recorded events [M987,M988] both attributed to key=K789
```
Lee: yep that's the pattern. M987 was provisional and never rolled back when M988 arrived. we incremented both.
Maria: we could move the billing increment to after dedupe resolution, but that pushes cost account confirmation until response end. may hurt latency-sensitive paths. alternative: provisional reservation + atomic switch: reserve tokens when request starts, mark used once we decide which reply is final
Maya: provisional reservation + rollback is safer for accuracy. add a metric for rolled_back_reservations and dedup_billed_tokens by org so we can track impact before/after fix
Olivia: for toolcalls specifically, proposal: dedupe-key = sha(org_id + request_id + tool_signature). attribute prompt tokens to caller immediately, attribute completion tokens to tool origin, and on retry check if tool result is identical/hash-equal to cache — if so, skip billing second completion
Samir: also note burst_exempt keys currently skip reservation. that's what makes the double-count surprising: no reservation means we rely entirely on finalization to avoid double charges. if we skip reservation, we must dedupe earlier in the pipeline
Lee: implementation plan: (1) compute dedupe-key at ingress, attach to request context; (2) metering writes provisional meter record with status=PENDING; (3) when final result chosen, update single record to FINAL or mark ROLLED_BACK for others; (4) ensure burst_exempt path still creates provisional records but with zero-reservation so quotas still see tentative usage
Jun: sounds good. I'll help validate with high-volume replay on staging tomorrow
Maya: add unit tests for: concurrent retries, mixed toolcall vs model-only, burst_exempt=true keys. and integration test that checks metering events count is idempotent per dedupe-key
Samir: I'll open PR with a small prototype and the log repro + unit tests. assigning to @Lee. ETA EOD tomorrow for review
Maria: please also add a console dashboard tile: dedup_billed_tokens (timeseries by org) + provisional_reservations currently_open. product wants to surface this to support earlier
Olivia: dropping my sample telemetry query here: `sum(billed_tokens) by (org) - sum(dedup_billed_tokens) by (org)` should highlight overbilling
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=fix/provisional-metering-ci status=queued
Samir: thx all. if anyone sees more examples drop logs in this thread. I'll follow up with PR link. :handshake:
